summary:
Agro-X intelligent assistant composed of catalogs of the agriculture area that helps you to automate. 
It is an agricultural decision support platform that integrates NASA ground-based observations, soil characteristics and crop information to design crop rotation strategies adapted to the conditions of each field. Its objective is to help farmers identify soil needs, assess climate scenarios and plan crop rotations that contribute to improving soil health, strengthening resilience to climate change and promoting more sustainable agriculture.
This project is important, since it helps farmers to take care of their land in an appropriate way to be able to cultivate through tips that the application will provide them. In addition, the farmer is informed of the climatic conditions by means of alerts, so it would help to prevent or reduce losses such as losses and waste, so it would help to preserve the raw material obtained through the harvest well.
details:
It operates under a model structured by value levels: a Free plan for a plot with monthly basic alerts, a Basic plan with daily alerts and risk advice, and a Pro plan for large producers. It is necessary to complete a profile when registering in the application with the information of the person, type of cultivation, number of hectares, cultivation time.

The Pomelli page was used to make the front end (HTML, CSS and JavaScript), backend: Python, Fast API, JSON, IA: Gemini.
